objective: Forward Gemini sampling, model choice, and finish reasons
success_conditions: An omitted temperature is absent from the Gemini generation config
A provided top_p is copied into the Gemini generation config as topP
An omitted top_p keeps the same cache key
A model name that starts with gemini returns that model in the Gemini request URL
A non-gemini model name returns the configured cloud model in the Gemini request URL
A Gemini MAX_TOKENS finish reason returns finish_reason length
A blocked Gemini prompt with no text returns HTTP 502 and does not call the secondary provider
